mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Pricing_Method as conPricingMethod, con.Con_Other_Valuation as conOtherValuation, con1.Con_Name as conAnnualName, con1.Con_Code as conAnnualCode, con1.Con_Pricing_Method as conAnnualPricingMethod, con1.Con_Other_Valuation as conAnnualOtherValuation, c1.C_Name as ctdCpyName, c1.C_Abbreviation as ctdCpyAbbName, c2.C_Name as ctdSoutCpyName, c2.C_Abbreviation as ctdSoutCpyAbbName, c3.C_Name as ctdQualityCpyName, c3.C_Abbreviation as ctdQualityCpyAbbName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Con_Task_Delegation mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id = pro.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Id = con.Con_Id left join Con_Contract con1 on mn.Con_Annual_Id=con1.Con_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on mn.Ctd_Cpy = c1.C_Id left join Sys_Company c2 on mn.Ctd_Sout_Cpy = c2.C_Id left join Sys_Company c3 on mn.Ctd_Quality_Cpy = c3.C_Id left join Sys_File f on mn.id = f.FileId where mn.Con_Annual_Id = #{conId} and mn.state=7 order by mn.Create_Time desc

select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Pricing_Method as conPricingMethod, con.Con_Other_Valuation as conOtherValuation, con1.Con_Name as conAnnualName, con1.Con_Code as conAnnualCode, con1.Con_Pricing_Method as conAnnualPricingMethod, con1.Con_Other_Valuation as conAnnualOtherValuation, c1.C_Name as ctdCpyName, c1.C_Abbreviation as ctdCpyAbbName, c2.C_Name as ctdSoutCpyName, c2.C_Abbreviation as ctdSoutCpyAbbName, c3.C_Name as ctdQualityCpyName, c3.C_Abbreviation as ctdQualityCpyAbbName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Con_Task_Delegation mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id = pro.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Id = con.Con_Id left join Con_Contract con1 on mn.Con_Annual_Id=con1.Con_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on mn.Ctd_Cpy = c1.C_Id left join Sys_Company c2 on mn.Ctd_Sout_Cpy = c2.C_Id left join Sys_Company c3 on mn.Ctd_Quality_Cpy = c3.C_Id left join Sys_File f on mn.id = f.FileId where mn.id = #{id}
